description: The ocean general circulation component in NESM is based on the Nucleus for European Modelling of the Ocean version 5.0 (NEMO v5.0; Madec et al., 2024), configured on the global tripolar ORCA1 Arakawa-C horizontal grid (~1.0 degree nominal resolution, 360 x 291 unique cells, with meridional refinement down to ~0.33 degrees near the Equator) and 46 vertical levels (6.19 m surface layer thickness). It solves the three-dimensional hydrostatic primitive equations using the NEMO v5.0 third-order Runge-Kutta (RK3) baroclinic time-stepping scheme with a split-explicit nonlinear free surface. Physical parameterizations include a turbulent kinetic energy (TKE) vertical mixing closure with enhanced internal wave mixing, lateral Laplacian momentum viscosity, isoneutral Laplacian tracer diffusion, and the Gent-McWilliams (GM) eddy-induced velocity parameterization.
